main_topic.en: Exchanging greetings in American English in various real-life situations.
main_topic.es: Intercambio de saludos en inglés americano en diversas situaciones reales.

image.alt_es: Dos personas adultas se saludan con una sonrisa y un gesto de la mano junto a una cafetería.
image.prompt: Candid editorial landscape photo of two adult neighbors smiling and waving hello on a neighborhood sidewalk beside a cafe. Natural daylight. No text, logos or watermark.

learning_objectives: Identificar saludos apropiados según el contexto.
Diferenciar entre saludos formales e informales.
Responder de manera natural a saludos comunes.
Reconocer el uso social de frases como 'nice to meet you' y 'good to see you'.
Practicar la pronunciación y el ritmo de saludos en inglés americano.

paragraphs.en: In America, greetings are part of everyday life. People choose their words based on time, place, and who they are talking to.
paragraphs.es: En Estados Unidos, los saludos son parte de la vida diaria. Las personas eligen sus palabras según la hora, el lugar y con quién hablan.

paragraphs.en: On a city sidewalk, two young men see each other. One says, "Hey, what's up?" The other replies, "Not much. How's it going?"
paragraphs.es: En una acera de la ciudad, dos jóvenes se ven. Uno dice: "Hey, what's up?" El otro responde: "Not much. How's it going?"

paragraphs.en: Early in the office, Olivia greets her manager with "Good morning." The manager replies, "Good morning, Olivia. How are you?" Olivia answers, "I'm good, thanks."
paragraphs.es: Temprano en la oficina, Olivia saluda a su jefa con "Good morning." La jefa responde: "Good morning, Olivia. How are you?" Olivia contesta: "I'm good, thanks."

paragraphs.en: At one p.m., coworkers returning from lunch say, "Good afternoon!" in the hallway. This is polite and friendly.
paragraphs.es: A la una de la tarde, colegas que regresan de almorzar se saludan en el pasillo con un "Good afternoon!" Es una forma educada y amistosa.

paragraphs.en: At six in the evening, Mark enters the gym and says, "Good evening." The receptionist smiles and repeats, "Good evening!"
paragraphs.es: A las seis de la tarde, Mark entra al gimnasio y dice: "Good evening." La recepcionista sonríe y repite: "Good evening!"

paragraphs.en: When Sarah leaves her friend's house late, she says, "Good night!" Her friend waves and says, "Good night, see you soon!"
paragraphs.es: Cuando Sarah sale tarde de la casa de su amiga, dice: "Good night!" Su amiga le hace un gesto y responde: "Good night, see you soon!"

paragraphs.en: At a party, two women meet for the first time. One says, "Hi, I'm Carla." The other responds, "Nice to meet you, Carla. I'm Julia."
paragraphs.es: En una fiesta, dos mujeres se conocen por primera vez. Una dice: "Hi, I'm Carla." La otra responde: "Nice to meet you, Carla. I'm Julia."

paragraphs.en: In a coffee shop, old friends run into each other. One says, "Long time no see!" The other grins, "Yeah, it's been a long time!"
paragraphs.es: En una cafetería, viejos amigos se encuentran. Uno dice: "Long time no see!" El otro sonríe: "Yeah, it's been a long time!"

paragraphs.en: Tom sees his coworker at the grocery store. He says, "Good to see you, Anna!" She replies, "Good to see you too, Tom!"
paragraphs.es: Tom ve a su compañera de trabajo en la tienda. Él dice: "Good to see you, Anna!" Ella responde: "Good to see you too, Tom!"

paragraphs.en: For casual greetings, people often say, "Hi," "Hello," or simply "Hey" to friends and neighbors.
paragraphs.es: Para saludos informales, la gente suele decir "Hi", "Hello" o simplemente "Hey" a amigos y vecinos.

paragraphs.en: Answering the phone in America, people usually say, "Hello?" or state their name, like "This is Jake."
paragraphs.es: Al contestar el teléfono en Estados Unidos, la gente suele decir "Hello?" o decir su nombre, como "This is Jake."

paragraphs.en: When hosting, it is polite to say, "Welcome! Come in!" This makes guests feel comfortable.
paragraphs.es: Cuando recibes invitados, es cortés decir, "Welcome! Come in!" Esto hace que los invitados se sientan cómodos.

paragraphs.en: In meetings, a polite greeting is "Good morning, everyone." This sets a positive tone.
paragraphs.es: En reuniones, un saludo educado es "Good morning, everyone." Esto crea un ambiente positivo.

paragraphs.en: After "How are you?", it's normal to answer, "I'm good, thanks. And you?" This keeps the conversation comfortable.
paragraphs.es: Después de "How are you?", es normal responder, "I'm good, thanks. And you?" Así la conversación es amena.

paragraphs.en: "What's up?" is informal. Friends usually answer, "Not much," or "Just working," before asking it back.
paragraphs.es: "What's up?" es informal. Los amigos suelen responder, "Not much," o "Just working," antes de devolver la pregunta.

paragraphs.en: Arriving late to class, Lisa quietly says, "Hi, sorry I'm late." The teacher replies, "No problem, Lisa. Find a seat."
paragraphs.es: Al llegar tarde a clase, Lisa dice en voz baja: "Hi, sorry I'm late." La profesora responde: "No problem, Lisa. Find a seat."

paragraphs.en: At the end of the workday, colleagues say, "Have a good day!" or "See you later!" before leaving.
paragraphs.es: Al final de la jornada laboral, los compañeros se despiden con "Have a good day!" o "See you later!" antes de irse.

paragraphs.en: When saying goodbye, some people say, "Take care!" This shows that you wish someone well.
paragraphs.es: Al despedirse, algunas personas dicen, "Take care!" Esto demuestra que deseas lo mejor al otro.

paragraphs.en: A new coworker joins the team. Sam introduces himself: "Hi, I'm Sam. Welcome to the team!"
paragraphs.es: Un nuevo compañero se une al equipo. Sam se presenta: "Hi, I'm Sam. Welcome to the team!"

paragraphs.en: Practicing greetings daily can help you sound friendly and confident in American English.
paragraphs.es: Practicar los saludos a diario puede ayudarte a sonar amable y seguro en inglés americano.

grammar.name: Time-of-day greetings
grammar.example_en: Early in the office, Olivia greets her manager with "Good morning." The manager replies, "Good morning, Olivia. How are you?" Olivia answers, "I'm good, thanks."
grammar.explanation_es: Good morning, good afternoon y good evening son saludos que se eligen según el momento del día.

grammar.name: Good night as a farewell
grammar.example_en: When Sarah leaves her friend's house late, she says, "Good night!" Her friend waves and says, "Good night, see you soon!"
grammar.explanation_es: Good night se usa al despedirse por la noche o antes de dormir, no como saludo habitual al llegar.

grammar.name: How questions with be
grammar.example_en: Early in the office, Olivia greets her manager with "Good morning." The manager replies, "Good morning, Olivia. How are you?" Olivia answers, "I'm good, thanks."
grammar.explanation_es: En How are you, are va antes de you para formar la pregunta con how y be.

grammar.name: Informal fixed question
grammar.example_en: On a city sidewalk, two young men see each other. One says, "Hey, what's up?" The other replies, "Not much. How's it going?"
grammar.explanation_es: What’s up? es una fórmula informal entre amigos o personas de confianza; una respuesta breve común es Not much.

grammar.name: To-infinitive in a fixed greeting
grammar.example_en: At a party, two women meet for the first time. One says, "Hi, I'm Carla." The other responds, "Nice to meet you, Carla. I'm Julia."
grammar.explanation_es: Nice to meet you contiene el infinitivo to meet y se usa normalmente al conocer a alguien por primera vez.

grammar.name: Polite imperative
grammar.example_en: When saying goodbye, some people say, "Take care!" This shows that you wish someone well.
grammar.explanation_es: Take care usa un imperativo como despedida amistosa, con el sentido de «cuídate».

grammar.name: Fixed farewell with see
grammar.example_en: At the end of the workday, colleagues say, "Have a good day!" or "See you later!" before leaving.
grammar.explanation_es: See you later es una fórmula fija de despedida; no es necesario decir una oración completa como I’ll see you later.

grammar.name: Welcoming expressions
grammar.example_en: When hosting, it is polite to say, "Welcome! Come in!" This makes guests feel comfortable.
grammar.explanation_es: Welcome se utiliza para recibir a alguien. Según el contexto puede acompañarse de una invitación como Please come in.

rounds.instructions_es: Lee cada párrafo en inglés, consulta la traducción en español y repítelo dos veces.
Practica con los siguientes fragmentos exactamente como están. Haz una pausa corta entre cada barra.

segments: Olivia greets her manager with "Good morning."
old friends run into each other.
At the end of the workday,
"Have a good day!" or "See you later!"

rounds.instructions_es: Lee los veinte párrafos sin detenerte en cada palabra. Concéntrate en ritmo y pronunciación.
